title: Add residency shield middleware, per-tenant KMS telemetry, and RBACv2 assertion sanitizer
author: Sana Patel
description: Motivation: customers with strict data residency requirements and complex key management setups asked for stronger runtime enforcement and better visibility into per-tenant KMS usage. This PR introduces a lightweight Residency Shield middleware that validates request claims and enforces region pinning policies early in the request path, a per-tenant KMS telemetry exporter to surface key selection and provider fallback events to the console, and an RBACv2 assertion sanitizer that strips unsafe claim combinations before policy evaluation. Changes are targeted at hosted and private control planes with opt-in gating for Dedicated until rollout is verified. Implementation summary: Residency Shield validates x-tenant-region and service-geo claims, consults the residency-policy cache and returns a 403 with structured audit tags if the request violates policy; it also attaches an immutable residency.verdict header for downstream components. KMS telemetry records selected provider, key-id hash, fallback_reason (if any), and latency buckets; metrics are emitted to the existing telemetry pipeline and a new tag residency_cohort. RBACv2 sanitizer normalizes attribute keys, removes cross-tenant impersonation attributes, and converts legacy role strings into canonical role IDs. Rollout plan: behind feature flag feature.residency_shield; gradual canary to 5% of traffic for 48h, monitor audit-error-rate and request-latency P95; if regressions observed, auto-fallback to policy-simulation mode that logs but does not enforce. Backwards compatibility: requests without residency claims default to existing routing behavior; sanitizer is conservative and only drops attributes that match denylist patterns. Testing: unit tests for middleware and sanitizer, integration tests exercising KMS provider fallback (mocked AWS/GCP/az), e2e in staging with synthetic tenants in three geozones. Security review: includes threat model doc and IAC changes to add new telemetry IAM roles. Docs: admin console addition documenting telemetry fields, new alert runbook for residency.verdict violations. Why different from prior karma: this PR focuses on observability + non-destructive enforcement and bridges KMS telemetry with residency policy decisions to aid auditability and incident reasoning.

files_changed_summary: Add middleware to gateway to enforce residency verdicts
Introduce KMS telemetry exporter and tie telemetry tags to residency cohorts
Add sanitizer for RBAC attribute normalization and denylist removal
Docs and runbook for residency enforcement and alerts
Feature flag and helm values for controlled rollout
review_conversation: Evan Liu: Can the residency verdict be forged by clients? Make sure header is immutable and only set by gateway. Author: Residency header is set server-side and validated by an HMAC signed attestation when crossing internal proxies.

Marissa Gomez: How do we avoid noisy alerts during rollout? Author: We include a simulation mode that logs as audit events and a sampling knob to avoid alert storms; added runbook that describes thresholds and step-down plan.
Owen Park: KMS telemetry contains key-id hashes—ensure hashing is salted and non-reversible. Author: We use tenant-scoped salt from KMS config; added unit tests to verify truncation and hashing.

Security Review (Anika Rao): Confirmed threat model and added remediation for header replay; recommended adding telemetry ACLs. Author: ACLs added in infra/iam/telemetry-role.tf and documented in ops runbook.

Marissa Gomez: observed a transient p95 spike in canary during integration run, suggested increasing cache TTL. Author: Increased residency cache TTL to 2s and added cache-miss metric to track impact.
release_notes: Add Residency Shield middleware to validate tenant-region claims and apply policy-driven enforcement; introduce per-tenant KMS telemetry with residency_cohort tagging; add RBACv2 attribute sanitizer to prevent unsafe attributes from reaching policy engine. Rollout is gated by feature flag. Operators: review new telemetry panels and update alert thresholds.
backout_instructions: Disable feature.residency_shield flag and re-deploy gateway config; telemetry exporter removal is non-blocking but should be disabled if immediate rollback required. For Dedicated customers use the console to switch to policy-simulation mode to avoid enforcement.
